//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder yönergesiyle istenen gözetimsiz inşa orkestratörünü (kalıcı kontrol durumu, kota otomasyonu, dar komut sözleşmeleri, review/remediation/merge/release/imza/Phase0 yürütücüleri, Task Scheduler kaydı) ve aynı commit'teki trust-root reseal'ini kaydeder; etkinleştirme bağımsız review CLEAN olduktan sonra yapılır, imza ssh-agent anahtarı tutana kadar bekler.
founderRequest: Implement and activate FULL UNATTENDED UASCO ORCHESTRATION: repository-native durable supervisor under Windows Task Scheduler (login, reboot, provider retry time, recoverable interruption), authoritative ORCHESTRATOR_STATE with atomic auditable transitions and no duplicate reviews after restart, complete Codex quota automation without consuming review/format/remediation retries and with FOUNDER_MANUAL_QUOTA_RESET support, automatic Claude -> Codex review loop with CLEAN integration and package-scoped remediation, narrow exact command contracts instead of blanket shell access, LOCAL_CLAUDE + CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION with AUTO routing and honest NOT_CONFIGURED cloud, release pipeline automation that never reuses an old signature, secure local unattended signing only through an OS-backed signer (otherwise WAITING_FOR_SECURE_SIGNER), GitHub checks without faking branch protection, Phase0 automation preserving failed attempts, dependency-aware lanes, no repeated Founder questions for approved policy, unattended end-to-end and adversarial tests, self-healing lock/lease/idempotency, separate bounded package, validation, commit, independent Codex review, activation after CLEAN.

founderAuthorization.rule: [Directive 2026-09-29] Implement this as a separate bounded autonomy-hardening package; commit it; send it through the existing independent Codex review loop; after CLEAN, activate the unattended supervisor; do not weaken the existing trust model; Task Scheduler / existing approved autostart mechanism for the supervisor; evidence-key ACL hardening and UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor Task Scheduler registration already approved; private signing key must never enter the repository, cloud, artifacts, logs or Claude/Codex, passphrase never stored in plaintext. [Permission 2026-09-29] İzni veriyorum. Ancak izin yalnızca bu autonomy-hardening paketinin repo içindeki dosyalarını ve önceden tanımlanmış exact command contracts kapsamını kapsasın. Şunlara blanket/genel izin VERME: arbitrary Bash / PowerShell / cmd, repo dışına yazma, credential export, signing private key erişimi, force push, trust/security policy weakening, bilinmeyen external network işlemleri. Paketi tamamla: kayıt betiği, senaryo/regression/adversarial testleri, dokümantasyon, reseal, commit, Codex independent review. Windows ssh-agent servisini Founder kendisi Administrator PowerShell'de etkinleştirir ve anahtarı kendisi ekler; bu tek sistem ayarı dışında paket devam eder.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

design.state: control section (2.0.0) validated on every write; transitions appended to a hash-chained JSONL log then written atomically; a tick refuses to run on a broken chain; process lock plus lease/heartbeat; in-flight markers recovered from stale workers.
design.engine: nextAction/applyOutcome are deterministic; dependencies and merge conditions gate eligibility; QUOTA blocks only the provider's actions and consumes no review cycle, format retry or remediation retry; BLOCKED -> remediation only with recorded authority and below the cycle limit, otherwise FOUNDER_DECISION_PENDING on that package only; transient errors back off (5 min doubling to 6 h) and escalate after 5 attempts; a reinstall over an accepted installation is a Founder decision.
design.executors: review adopts a completed run for the same bundle digest and cycle, runs the canonical broker otherwise, records environment-block.json on quota, evaluates with the ported supervisor-equivalent governance and records evidence; merge is fast-forward only after checking the CLEAN evidence and the tree; packaging adopts a complete release, otherwise exports, verifies, builds SHA256SUMS and a deterministic ZIP, verifies a fresh extract with validation and supersedes older releases without deleting; signing uses only ssh-agent with the public key and adopts valid signatures; Phase0 preserves the previous install as a failed attempt and reads the result only from PHASE0_ACCEPTANCE.json; builder rounds route through execution-routing, enforce scope and recorded protected authority, reseal when needed, validate twice and build the next frozen bundle.
design.contracts: fixed programs, typed parameters, paths only under policy roots, no shell, no deletion/force push/credential export contracts; env override only for repository node scripts (brokers need safeChildEnv).
design.portEquivalence: The ported review pipeline reproduced the manual tools on real data: the PKG-R2 run re-evaluated to the same review sha256 and effective review digest (CLEAN), the PKG-X1 bundle rebuilt identical except frozenAt/runId/digests, and the precheck passed on the real PKG-X1 review clone through the real contract runner.
design.cloud: claude --cloud is an official CLI option, but cloud sessions need the GitHub repository and autonomous pushes are not allowed while branch protection is unavailable; CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION stays NOT_CONFIGURED with the discovery recorded.
design.signer: Windows ssh-agent was DISABLED/STOPPED at implementation time; the Founder enables it and loads the key personally; until then releases wait in WAITING_FOR_SECURE_SIGNER while all other work continues.

reseal.runAfter: all protected edits of this commit, with no other untracked or ignored files under protected prefixes

rebase.reason: PKG-X1 was remediated in cycle 2 (commit 3d430dd, governed CLEAN run 3d430dd-c2-20260929T042239Z-broker); the stacked AUT1 package was re-applied on top of it so the fast-forward chain stays linear. The only conflict was config/trust-root-manifest.json, regenerated by the unchanged generator. The original AUT1 commit was never reviewed; its frozen cycle-1 bundle is superseded without a review result.

preReviewHardening.trigger: Codex review of PKG-T1 (run 22d4cfe-c1-20260929T040427Z-broker, F-T1-001) showed the crash/resume test fabricated adoption; checking the real path showed findCompletedRun adopted only runs that already had governed-result.json, so a worker killed after the Codex call completed but before governed evaluation would call the provider again after restart.
preReviewHardening.fix: findCompletedRun still prefers the latest EVALUATED run; otherwise, if the latest run for the same bundle digest and cycle finished with exit code 0 and its review-result.json still matches the manifest hash, it is returned with governed:null and the review executor evaluates that output in the prepared review clone instead of calling Codex again. An unfinished call (no exit code), a non-zero exit, a changed output or an older run superseded by a later call is never adopted.
preReviewHardening.test: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario completed-unevaluated-review-run-adopted-incomplete-or-tampered-run-not (17/17); the executor-level crash path is exercised by the remediated PKG-T1 crash/resume selftest.
preReviewHardening.authority: inside the recorded PKG-AUT1 Founder authorization (automation/lib/review-pipeline.mjs and automation/lib/orchestrator-executors.mjs are new AUT1 files); strengthens idempotency, no policy or authority change

remediation.authority: Remediation of admissible Codex blockers inside the recorded PKG-AUT1 Founder authorization: only AUT1's own protected files change (automation/lib/command-contracts.mjs, review-pipeline.mjs, orchestrator-engine.mjs, orchestrator-executors.mjs, scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs, scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs, regenerated trust-root manifest); every change makes the control plane stricter or fail-closed; the existing Phase0 verifier (automation/lib/control-boundary.mjs, phase0-contract.mjs) is reused unchanged.

F-AUT1-001.fix: runTick checks shouldStop (Global Stop) before every action and does not apply an action cut short by the stop (its in-flight marker is recovered idempotently); createContractRunner refuses every command while the stop is active and, with the default spawner, runs commands under spawnMonitored, which polls the stop and terminates the whole command tree (System32 taskkill /T /F on Windows, process group elsewhere); a terminated command throws GLOBAL_STOP_ACTIVE; the CLI wires the repository Global Stop into both.
F-AUT1-001.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F001-... (stop during an action ends the tick; a terminated action is not applied; no action or command starts during a stop; a running command tree including a grandchild is terminated).

F-AUT1-002.fix: findCompletedRun no longer reads governed-result.json; it returns the latest finished run for the bundle, cycle and prompt whose output matches its manifest hash, and the review executor always re-derives governance with evaluateReviewRun (which now also binds the output to the manifest hash and the bundle digest). The merge gate re-derives the decision from the evidence record (unchanged reviewer text, manifest output hash, recomputed frozen-bundle digest, identity) with rederiveGovernedFromEvidence using the control plane's schemas and settings.
F-AUT1-002.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F002-... (a cached CLEAN over BLOCKED output is re-evaluated to BLOCKED without a provider call; merge rejects it before any git command; tampered text or bundle is rejected).

F-AUT1-003.fix: builderRound classifies changed files against the verified control plane's config/protected-paths.json instead of the builder worktree copy, so emptying the policy in the worktree cannot hide protected edits; the rejection happens before any worktree code (trust-root generator, validation) runs.
F-AUT1-003.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F003-... (policy removal plus a protected script edit, and a protected edit alone, are rejected with PROTECTED_CHANGE_NOT_AUTHORIZED; run-validation is never invoked).

F-AUT1-004.fix: A QUEUED outcome records queuedAction; nextAction resumes a queued REMEDIATE as REMEDIATE, so the findings, frozen contract, ledger and next cycle are kept; COMMITTED clears the marker.

F-AUT1-005.fix: FORMAT_REJECTED stores formatRejection {runDir, reason} separately from the last valid review; the correction prompt is built from that exact run and reason; adoption filters runs by prompt file, so only a run made with the correction prompt is adopted; a later valid review clears the correction state. Each provider call gets a unique run directory (milliseconds plus suffix).
F-AUT1-005.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F005-... (the second prompt carries the real rejection reason and the malformed output; exactly one correction call).

F-AUT1-006.fix: Packaging is adopted only if the release directory is intact; the signing handoff (ZIP, sidecar, SHA256SUMS.txt, packaging record) is verified file by file and missing or altered copies are repaired from the verified sources (altered copies kept as .invalid-<time>); the record is written last; an incomplete sign directory is preserved as -incomplete-<time> before a rebuild instead of failing with SIGN_DIR_EXISTS.

F-AUT1-007.fix: If the deterministic implementation clone is dirty (interrupted or quota-limited round), it is renamed to .partial-<time> with a status record (never deleted) and the round is retried in a fresh clone.
F-AUT1-007.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F007-... (the partial edit is preserved, the retry commits only the new round's files).

F-AUT1-008.fix: Signatures are verified and adopted individually; only missing or invalid signatures are created and an invalid one is kept as .invalid-<time>.
F-AUT1-008.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F008-... (with a valid ZIP signature and a missing sums signature only the sums file is signed).

F-AUT1-009.fix: phase0OutcomeFrom accepts Phase0 only with the trusted verifier result (verifyPhase0ForControl: schema, Ed25519 signature, installId/source commit/trust-root/input binding), the signed release's trust-root digest, complete install steps without FAIL and, for fresh installs, installer exit 0; a finished install that does not verify is preserved as a failed attempt instead of adopted.
F-AUT1-009.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c2-F009-... (a real signed report bound to a git-backed install is accepted; an unsigned one and every missing binding are rejected).

F-AUT1-010.observed: merge re-derived governance from the bundle embedded in the evidence and compared only reviewedCommit and cycle with the package, so internally consistent CLEAN evidence for another bundle on the same commit and cycle was accepted.
F-AUT1-010.fix: rederiveGovernedFromEvidence also returns the recomputed bundle digest and base commit; the merge gate requires the evidence and its recomputed frozen bundle digest to equal the package's frozen bundle digest and the base, reviewed commit and cycle to match before any git operation. The review executor checks that the placed bundle (recomputed digest, base, reviewed commit, cycle) is the package's frozen bundle before adopting or reviewing.
F-AUT1-010.retest: scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs scenario aut1c3-F010-... (CLEAN evidence for another bundle on the same commit/cycle, another base and a missing frozen digest are rejected with zero git calls; matching evidence merges; a swapped bundle file is rejected as FROZEN_BUNDLE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH without a provider call).

mutationCheck.method: each fix reverted alone in the working tree, scripts/orchestrator-selftest.mjs rerun, files restored byte-identical

founderCycle3Authorization.source: Founder answer 2026-09-29: Onayla: F-AUT1-010 + betiksiz benimseme
scope: script-free adoption required by the frozen PKG-T2 acceptance criterion

scriptFreeAdoption.reason: Founder-authorized cycle-3 scope; the frozen PKG-T2 criterion requires adoption without provider or script calls
scriptFreeAdoption.fix: a completed run is re-evaluated in a review tree prepared with git only (clone/fetch/checkout/clean status); dependency and provenance scripts run only before a new provider call.
scriptFreeAdoption.retest: aut1c3-F010-... (a second review of a completed run adds zero non-git process calls).

mutations: adoption back to full clone preparation

successor.decision: Founder answer 2026-09-30 (Halef paket, tam kapsam): the PKG-AUT1 lineage (two BLOCKED cycles) is closed without merge and without a CLEAN claim; the cycle-3 commit c48d54d is reviewed as PKG-AUT1B at cycle 1 with the full scope; the two-cycle rule applies to PKG-AUT1B.

F-AUT1B-001.observed: verifyTransitionLog only checked that a prevHash existed somewhere in the log, so replayed genesis or intermediate entries and sequence gaps (1 -> 99) were accepted; seq 1 skipped the link check.
F-AUT1B-001.fix: automation/lib/orchestrator-state.mjs: the log is verified as a strictly linear chain (first entry seq 1 on genesis, every entry the previous seq + 1 and linked to the previous hash, no duplicate hash) and the state's last transition must be in the log with the same seq; commitTransition links every new entry to the actual last log entry and, after an append-before-state-write crash, records recoveredFrom (the applied transition) and voids (exactly the unapplied entries after it), which verification checks; entries after the state's transition are reported as unapplied.
F-AUT1B-001.retest: aut1b-F001-transition-log-rejects-replays-gaps-and-forged-recovery-and-reconciles-a-real-interrupted-transition: replayed genesis and intermediate entries, a seq gap, a 1 -> 99 log, a forged reconciliation, a state transition outside the log and a commit on a diverged state are rejected; a real interrupted transition is reported as one unapplied entry, reconciled by the next transition, and never reaches the state; the real control-plane log (61 entries) is strictly linear and verifies unchanged.

F-AUT1B-002.observed: applyOutcome persisted a provider retry time that was already in the past, so providerDue made the package eligible again immediately and one tick made six review calls.
F-AUT1B-002.fix: automation/lib/orchestrator-engine.mjs: futureIso accepts a provider retry time only when it is valid and later than now; otherwise the policy backoff is persisted (Codex and Claude quota, and the queue notBefore).
F-AUT1B-002.retest: aut1b-F002-a-stale-provider-retry-time-yields-one-attempt-and-a-future-policy-backoff: exactly one review call per tick with a stale dated retry time, the policy backoff persisted, no cycle, format or remediation counter consumed; invalid times fall back, valid future times are honoured; stale builder and queue times fall back as well.

F-AUT1B-003.observed: the contract runner started plain git with the inherited environment, so GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS and GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF reached checkout and commit, which could run hooks or helpers outside the allowlist.
F-AUT1B-003.fix: automation/lib/command-contracts.mjs: every Git contract runs with isolatedGitArgs/isolatedGitEnv from automation/lib/git-isolation.mjs (unchanged), drops GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS and adds commit.gpgSign=false and tag.gpgSign=false; Global Stop monitoring is unchanged.
F-AUT1B-003.retest: aut1b-F003-git-contracts-run-isolated-and-injected-configuration-cannot-start-hooks-or-signers: with injected GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS (hooks path, mandatory signing through a missing signer) and GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, the recorded contract call carries none of them and has the isolation arguments; a real git.commitAll through the contract succeeds unsigned and no injected hook runs, while the same configuration is effective on unisolated Git (negative control).

successor.mutationCheck: each fix reverted alone makes exactly its scenario fail: original orchestrator-state.mjs -> replayed genesis accepted; original orchestrator-engine.mjs -> 6 review calls in one tick; original command-contracts.mjs -> injected Git variables forwarded; with all fixes 29/29
successor.unchangedProtectedHelper: automation/lib/git-isolation.mjs is not changed (it is not among the Founder-authorized PKG-AUT1 protected files); the extra GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS removal and signing override are applied in the contract runner
